newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Renault head called to Brussels over plant closure.
newsitem.headline: Renault head called to Brussels over plant closure.

text.p: Belgium's Flemish regional government has summoned Renault president and chief executive officer Louis Schweitzer to a meeting in Brussels on Saturday over the company's decision to close its Belgian plant.
The government said in a statement Schweitzer will meet Flemish government President Luc Van den Brande at 1200 local (1100 GMT).

The meeting will be preceded by talks on Friday afternoon between Van den Brande and France's ambassador to Belgium and a meeting with politicians from Vilvoorde, the town where the doomed Renault factory is based.
Van den Brande said he was "profoundly shocked by the brutal and unacceptable decision to close the Renault factory at Vilvoorde, which is not based on any objective economic grounds."
